scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem classifies only nonzero structure constants on one directed cycle of length at least two over a finite field. Multiple-cycle and zero-weight permutation algebras are excluded. The proof is field-theoretic and independent of the finite verification. A residual originality risk remains because the 2023 general finite-field idempotent-evolution-algebra paper was inspected only through its abstract and bibliographic material; no all-dimensional fixed-cycle specialization was located.
title: Finite-field forms of cyclic permutation evolution algebras
